text:
Marta: Hey support, we're getting intermittent 400s from /v1/rerank after a recent edge change. Example request+response:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer XXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Encoding: gzip" \
  --data-binary @payload.gz
```
Response: 400 Bad Request {"error":"malformed request JSON at char 512"}
Payload (pre-gzip):
```json
{"model":"rdr/rerank-1","top_k":3,"candidates":[{"id":123,"text":"foo"},{"id":"124","text":"bar","score":"0.8"},{}]}
```
This only started after we enabled gzip on our edge proxy. Repro rate ~1/6 requests.

Alex: can you paste the request-id from the response headers and attach the payload.gz? Also, quick check: our spec expects candidate objects with at least `id` and `text` and does not accept client-supplied `score` (we ignore unknown fields but empty objects will fail). But the intermittent failure + gzip sounds like the proxy might be truncating the gz stream.

Marta: request-id: req_01GZXY9HBKZT7, attached payload.gz (small). We can reliably repro in prod if we replay ~50 requests. Disabling gzip makes it go away. :confused:

Kai: checked ingress for req_01GZXY9HBKZT7 — parser error shows `Unexpected end of JSON input` at byte ~498. Backend log also flags `invalid candidate object at index 2: missing id/text`. So two things: (1) the payload actually got truncated, leaving the last candidate as `{}`; (2) one candidate includes a `score` string which violates client expectations (score is not a recognized input field). The truncation explains intermittent nature.

Alex: can you try a quick repro without gzip (same payload via --data-raw) and confirm? If plain JSON succeeds, that's strong evidence for the edge re-chunking/truncation. Also let us know SDK version you use.

Marta: plain JSON (no Content-Encoding) => all requests succeed. We're on internal SDK v2.3.3 that adds gzip support.

InfraBot: opened INFRA-4123: edge proxy bug — re-chunking gzipped bodies may close connection early for certain request sizes. Assigned to @infra-team. Short-term mitigation: 1) disable gzip for /v1/rerank endpoints at edge, 2) ensure client sets Content-Length when sending gzipped body, 3) avoid streaming/chunked uploads for small payloads.

Kai: additional client-side mitigation: validate candidate objects before sending (no empty objects), coerce ids to strings or consistently typed values, and remove any `score` field from client payloads. SDK patch planned: v2.3.5 will validate and stringify ids.

Alex: summarizing: root cause = edge gz stream truncation + client sent an empty candidate object (after truncation) + client-sent `score` as string (non-spec). Workarounds in place (disabled gzip for rerank + client validation).

Marta: thanks team — disabling gzip on that route fixed it for us. We'll upgrade SDK when 2.3.5 is out. :thumbsup:

Kai: will keep INFRA-4123 open until root cause fixed in proxy. Marking support ticket as resolved pending infra fix.

Marta: closing on our side, will re-open if we see more failures. Cheers! :raised_hands:
